summary: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $3.75 billion senior notes offering, with proceeds earmarked to finance its pending cash acquisition of MarketAxess Holdings for $167.00 per share, approximately $6.0 billion aggregate. The merger agreement dated July 29, 2026, requires MarketAxess stockholder approval, HSR clearance, and other regulatory approvals. The 2033 and 2036 notes carry a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the acquisition fails by July 29, 2027 (extendable to July 29, 2028) or if the merger agreement terminates. Watch for regulatory clearances and closing conditions; risk-arb centers on deal completion timeline.
